text.what: A Swiss research-station selection that reached Oregon early and stayed. Lighter in colour, higher in aromatics, and often blended against Pommard to fill the middle.
text.how: Named for the Swiss federal research station at Wädenswil on Lake Zurich, and distributed in America through UC Davis as UCD 1A and 2A.

kin.as: Its planting partner in old Oregon blocks.
